Class Disc

java.lang.Object
net.murat.shape.Disc
All Implemented Interfaces:
EMShape
public class Disc extends Object implements EMShape
Disc class represents a flat circular disc in 3D space. The disc lies in the XY plane in its local coordinate system, centered at the origin (0,0,0) with its normal along the Z-axis. Implements EMShape interface with full transformation support.

This implementation is 100% garbage-free during render() execution. All temporary objects are pre-allocated as instance fields and reused.

    • intersectAll

      public List<IntersectionInterval> intersectAll(Ray ray)
      Calculates the intersection interval for this (zero-thickness) disc.

      A disc is a single planar surface, so the ray either misses it or crosses it at exactly one t value. The returned interval is therefore degenerate: tEnter == tExit. CSG operations treat this as an instantaneous boundary crossing.

      Like intersect(Ray, Intersection), the local-space ray direction is intentionally left un-normalized, so t stays in the parametrization of the incoming ray (point = origin + direction * t) even when this disc has a scale. This is required for CSG, because the CSG combine step compares t values coming from different child shapes.

      Note: This method returns pre-allocated objects. The caller must NOT modify the returned objects as they are reused.

      Specified by:
      intersectAll in interface EMShape
      Parameters:
      ray - The ray to test, in the caller's coordinates
      Returns:
      A singleton list with one degenerate interval if hit, otherwise empty list.
